Stage 1-2 facts (stage 3 pending):
- Change origin: deploy/deploys.log:4 at 08:16:21Z deployed build 7.20.4-0a00. Its release-notes-7.20.4-0a00.md:16 set db.pool.max_size 48->12. Line 8 set the rates timeout to 600.
- stage-2/deploy/changes.log:2 CHG-5489 APPLIED rates timeout_ms=3500. This fixed the timeouts.
- Current symptom: stage-2/logs/quotes-api.log:285 at 09:49:14Z shows "db pool exhausted 12/12, waited 5000ms". There are 110 such errors.
- On-call note (yaml says 48) is stale.
- Leading cause: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED, current value 12. Remedy: RAISE_DB_POOL_LIMIT.
- Next: advance to stage 3 and check for any APPLIED pool change.
